headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, with AI‑driven firms leading the upside.
summary: Most listed firms reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS delivered the highest operating margin at 24% and strong cash flow. HCLTech highlighted AI sales as a key driver, posting a 21% profit rise. Some companies, such as Persistent, saw profit pressure despite revenue gains.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue grew sharply for HCLTech, LTM and Wipro, underpinning profit and margin improvements.

themes.title: Margin expansion at the top tier
themes.detail: TCS maintained a 24% operating margin, the highest among peers, reflecting scale and pricing power.

leaders.why: 24% operating margin and 15.4% YoY revenue growth.
21% YoY profit rise driven by strong AI sales.

laggards.why: Net profit slipped 25% QoQ despite 30% revenue growth.
